lines.text: How many times would you have to fold a sheet of paper to cross the entire universe?
Seven folds: as thick as a notebook.
Twenty-three: taller than the Burj Khalifa.
Sixty-nine: it reaches the nearest star.
Eighty-three: across the entire Milky Way.
And at one hundred and three folds...
it's wider than the observable universe.
One sheet of paper. That's the power of doubling. What should we double next?
